definition: the line or border where a surface or object ends
description: A hand slides along the rim of a wooden picnic table until the fingers stop right where the top ends. At a lakeside camp two people pull a rope to the corner of a tarp, and a blue-haired person walks carefully out a narrow dock, pointing down, until their toes stop at the very end above the water.
transcript: Got it. Whoa. All the way.
